skill.name: brand-guidelines
skill.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
skill.summary: Applies Anthropic brand colors, typography, and visual styling guidance to documents and presentations.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent Anthropic-inspired styling across documents and presentations. This skill supplies color, typography, and layout guidance for branded artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Provides Anthropic brand color values for main and accent palettes.
Specifies Poppins for headings and Lora for body text.
Recommends Arial and Georgia fallbacks when custom fonts are unavailable.
Guides text color selection based on background contrast.
Guides shape and accent color use across orange, blue, and green.
References RGB color handling for presentation-oriented workflows.
limitations: Does not include executable styling scripts or design templates.
Requires available fonts for the closest visual match.
Does not verify official brand compliance beyond the included guidance.
Focuses on visual styling, not brand messaging or legal review.

use_cases.title: Style Team Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply consistent colors, fonts, and accent choices to internal slide decks.

use_cases.title: Refresh Documentation
use_cases.description: Update reports, briefs, and handouts with a consistent Anthropic-inspired visual system.

use_cases.title: Review Brand Fit
use_cases.description: Check whether headings, body text, and accent colors match the provided brand guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Short Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Anthropic brand styling guidance to this one-page document. Use the defined colors, heading font, body font, and fallbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle a Slide Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this slide deck and suggest brand-aligned updates for colors, typography, shape accents, and text hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Visual Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a mixed set of assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these assets against the Anthropic brand guidance. Identify inconsistent colors, font choices, contrast problems, and accent misuse.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Brand Application Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise styling plan for applying this brand system to a report, a presentation, and a handout.

output_examples.input: A slide deck uses several bright colors and mixed fonts.
output_examples.output: Use the main dark and light colors for structure, then reserve orange, blue, and green for accents. Set headings in Poppins and body text in Lora.

output_examples.input: A report needs a more consistent visual identity.
output_examples.output: Apply the light background, dark body text, and restrained accent colors. Use font fallbacks only when Poppins or Lora are unavailable.

output_examples.input: A designer wants a quick brand check before sharing a handout.
output_examples.output: Check that headings use the heading font, body text uses the body font, and secondary elements use the defined gray palette.

best_practices: Use the main colors for structure before adding accents.
Keep typography consistent across all pages or slides.
Check contrast after applying light or dark backgrounds.
anti_patterns: Mixing unrelated brand colors with the defined palette.
Using accent colors for large text-heavy backgrounds.
Changing fonts slide by slide without a clear hierarchy.

faq.question: What does this skill help style?
faq.answer: It helps style documents, presentations, and visual artifacts with Anthropic-inspired colors and typography.

faq.question: Does it install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Poppins and Lora, with Arial and Georgia as fallbacks.

faq.question: Can it create brand-compliant layouts?
faq.answer: It can guide layout styling, but it does not replace official brand approval.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users provide?
faq.answer: Users should provide the artifact or describe the format, audience, and styling goals.
